<?php
// Read input
$line1 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$line2 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$line3 = trim(fgets(STDIN));

list($HPY, $ATKY, $DEFY) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line1));
list($HPM, $ATKM, $DEFM) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line2));
list($hCost, $aCost, $dCost) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line3));

$INF = 1e18;
$ans = $INF;

// Upper bounds for search
// ATK: need at least DEFM+1 to deal damage; search up to DEFM + 200
// DEF: to reduce damage; search up to ATKM + 200
$maxAtk = $DEFM + 200;
$maxDef = $ATKM + 200;

for ($atk = 1; $atk <= $maxAtk; $atk++) {
    for ($def = 0; $def <= $maxDef; $def++) {
        $damageToMonster = max(0, $atk - $DEFM);
        if ($damageToMonster == 0) continue; // can't win

        $damageToYang = max(0, $ATKM - $def);

        // Rounds needed for Yang to kill monster
        $roundsToKill = intdiv($HPM + $damageToMonster - 1, $damageToMonster);

        // Yang's HP needed to survive those rounds
        $neededHP = 1; // must stay >0
        if ($damageToYang > 0) {
            $neededHP = $damageToYang * ($roundsToKill - 1) + 1;
        }

        $extraHP = max(0, $neededHP - $HPY);
        $extraAtk = max(0, $atk - $ATKY);
        $extraDef = max(0, $def - $DEFY);

        $cost = $extraHP * $hCost + $extraAtk * $aCost + $extraDef * $dCost;
        if ($cost < $ans) $ans = $cost;
    }
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

$INF = 1e18;
$ans = $INF;

// Boundaries for brute force search
// ATK and DEF need not be very large; 0..200 is safe given constraints.
for ($atk = 0; $atk <= 200; $atk++) {
    for ($def = 0; $def <= 200; $def++) {
        $yangAtk = $ATKY + $atk;
        $yangDef = $DEFY + $def;

        // Damage Yang deals to monster per second

        // Number of seconds to kill monster
        $turnsToKillM = intdiv($HPM + $dmgToM - 1, $dmgToM);

        // Minimum HP Yang needs so that he survives all turns
        // Yang loses dmgToY each second; after (turnsToKillM - 1) hits he must still be > 0
        $neededHP = 1;
        if ($dmgToY > 0) {
            $neededHP = $dmgToY * ($turnsToKillM - 1) + 1;
        }

        $extraHP = max(0, $neededHP - $HPY);

        $cost = $extraHP * $hCost + $atk * $aCost + $def * $dCost;
        if ($cost < $ans) $ans = $cost;
    }
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>
